checks.name: Native binding is immutable, additive and private
Intent and public start share one transaction; success before durable admission is refused
Admission cannot change call, tool, generation or duplicate a delivery
Settled receipt digest and public tool end commit atomically, exact retry remains idempotent
Exact native ID/digest is associated; public recovery excludes private body/binding/native fields
Later native ID or body mutation conflicts and cannot reset the captured receipt
Tool settled then host interruption preserves result evidence but never completes the task
Undelivered planned operation is never sent or effect-checked on recovery
Effect already exists but tool-end/native result absent is read-only reconciled, not replayed
Unknown effect stays needs_check and cannot become recorded from an empty native tail
A real receipt insert failure rolls back public event/outbox and closes future delivery
Recovery receipt, public recovery event and terminal projection roll back together
Public schema refuses extra private fields and automatic action replay
Database construction defers native root until recovery, after constructor authority exists
Prototype receipt migration retains nullable unknown admission, never fabricates proof of non-delivery

scope: Actual SQLite transactions, owner admission, receipt and recovery negatives; controlled readback callbacks, not actual main crash/provider/UI
